messages:
maria.docs: Heads-up: preview for PR #1892 failed — markdown-lint and vale both erroring. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc123

docs-ci-bot: preview failed — summary:
- linkcheck: 1 broken link
- md-lint: MD033 (inline HTML), MD013 (line length)
- vale: PassiveVoice in migration-guide.md:213

jamal.eng: can you paste the ci output or paste the failing lines?

maria.docs: sure, pasted the relevant bits below:
```
[md-lint] migration-guide.md: MD013 Line length > 120 (expected 100)
[md-lint] images/diagram.png: MD033 Inline HTML detected
[vale] migration-guide.md:213 PassiveVoice: "a migration was performed"
[linkcheck] docs/migration-guide.md: broken link -> https://old.example.com/step-5
```

sam.devex: I can take the image alt + linkcheck. @olivia.md can you handle the vale passive-voice rewrites?

olivia.md: On it. Quick q: do we need to preserve the passive construction for legal wording in the migration section? If so, I can rework surrounding sentences to avoid the rule firing.

jamal.eng: quick patch notes: add alt text like `![routing diagram](/assets/route-diagram.png)` for images, wrap long paragraphs at ~100 chars, and replace the broken external link with the internal redirect or archive link.

maria.docs: plan: i'll open a small follow-up branch `docs/1892/ci-fix` with: alt text updates, linewrap, and the vale rewrites. push -> preview -> merge if green. @sam.devex please add yourself as reviewer.

sam.devex: :thumbsup: will review as soon as CI runs.

docs-ci-bot: Preview build queued for branch `docs/1892/ci-fix` (job r2). estimate ~10m. preview url: https://ci.redwood.ai/previews/1892

maria.docs: pushed `docs/1892/ci-fix` — included small commit that updates three `![...](...)` instances and wraps the long blocks. Also swapped the old external link for https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://old.example.com/step-5

docs-ci-bot: Preview succeeded for `docs/1892/ci-fix` — results:
- linkcheck: OK
- md-lint: OK
- vale: 0 warnings ✅

olivia.md: Rewrote the passive sentences to active voice, e.g. "A migration was performed" -> "We ran the migration" and added a short example snippet.

jamal.eng: sounds good. merging during doc-merge-window at 16:00 PST unless any objections.

sam.devex: No objections. Merge after CI green.

maria.docs: thanks all — nice quick team fix. Will close the original PR after the merge and add a note to changelog about the alt text fix.
